name: MiniMax-H3-Image — edit a picture
title: Edit a picture, large and sharp
summary: Give it a picture and say what to change; everything else stays where it was, and the result comes back larger, at about 4 megapixels.
description: Edit a picture by describing the change, with MiniMax-H3-Image (the same checkpoint as its text-to-image card). The picture is read as <Picture 1> in the instruction; the model rewrites what the instruction asks for and keeps the rest of the frame. The picture is first scaled to the working size (4 megapixels by default: the model does not work well at low resolution) and the result takes its shape, so a small picture comes back larger. About 19 seconds once the models are loaded. 6 distilled steps, no CFG. On a test asking for night time it kept every figure and object exactly in place but made a blue dusk rather than a dark night: name the light you want (lamps, shadows, darkness). The prompt improver, which would turn a short instruction into a full description of the result, fails on this ComfyUI build, so it is off. Experimental.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax-H3-Image — model card (MiniMax)
promptGuides.tip: Describe the whole picture in English, in detail. There is no negative prompt: write what to avoid into the prompt too. Your pictures are <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>… in upload order.
